description: A world's clients (PLAN_GAME_SERVER.md): the game draws what a q:gameserver world says each player sees and asks it what the player does; the world's file is read as the game compiles

examples.intent: A world's client: its view drawn, its commands sent, its events and refusals heard

input.natural_language: The den's game: the hero and the rats the world says the player sees, drawn with their health; the arrows step, a click on a rat attacks it, S shouts; a hit floats up as a number, a refusal is shown, and the HUD reads the hero's gold and health from the world

expected_output.quantum_code:
<q:application id="den-client" type="game">
  <!-- a world's client: the world (its commands, views, events and kinds) is the server's file, read as the game compiles -->
  <qg:connect world="tests/gameserver/worlds/den/den.server.q" />
  <qg:input action="shout" keys="S" />
  <qg:input action="bag" keys="B" />
  <qg:tileset name="land" src="tests/gameserver/worlds/den/den.png" tile="16" />
  <qg:spritesheet name="folk" src="tests/gameserver/worlds/den/folk.png" tile="16" />
  <qg:spritesheet name="beasts" src="tests/gameserver/worlds/den/rat.png" tile="16" />
  <!-- each kind of the world's entities, drawn: me is the entity as the world sent it -->
  <qg:prefab name="Hero" sheet="folk" frame="0" hitbox="12x14">
    <qg:label value="{me.name}" dy="-14" size="8" />
    <qg:health-bar value="{me.hp}" max="{me.max_hp}" dy="-9" />
  </qg:prefab>
  <qg:prefab name="Rat" sheet="beasts" frame="0" hitbox="12x10">
    <qg:health-bar value="{me.hp}" max="{me.max_hp}" dy="-8" color="#e04040" />
  </qg:prefab>
  <q:set name="note" value="" />
  <q:set name="hits" value="0" type="number" />
  <qg:scene name="den" width="320" height="180" world="true">
    <qg:tilemap tileset="land" src="tests/gameserver/worlds/den/den.tmx" />
    <qg:mirror view="around" />
    <qg:camera follow="me" bounds="tilemap" />
    <qg:on-input action="right"><qg:send command="step" dir="east" /></qg:on-input>
    <qg:on-input action="left"><qg:send command="step" dir="west" /></qg:on-input>
    <qg:on-input action="shout"><qg:send command="shout" /></qg:on-input>
    <qg:on-select>
      <q:if condition="{other != null and other.kind == 'Rat'}"><qg:send command="attack" who="{other.id}" /></q:if>
    </qg:on-select>
    <qg:cursor grid="16" step="0" />
    <qg:on-event name="hit">
      <q:set name="hits" value="{hits + 1}" />
      <qg:emit text="{str(value)}" at="other" color="#ff5555" />
    </qg:on-event>
    <qg:on-refused><q:set name="note" value="{reason}" /></qg:on-refused>
    <qg:on-input action="bag"><q:set name="note" value="{str(len(entries(me().bag))) + ' kinds of things in the bag'}" /></qg:on-input>
    <qg:hud position="top-left" size="8">
      <qg:text value="{(me().name + ' ' + str(me().gold) + ' gold') if connected() else 'Coming in...'}" />
      <qg:bar value="{me().hp}" max="{me().max_hp}" width="60" height="6" />
      <qg:text value="{note}" color="#ff5555" />
    </qg:hud>
  </qg:scene>
</q:application>

examples.intent: A world of a site's accounts: sign in on the title, then into the world

input.natural_language: Outpost's door: an account and a password (in dots) on the title; Enter the world asks the site for a ticket, forgets the password, and goes to the mainland, where the world lets the account in; a refusal of the site is shown

expected_output.quantum_code:
<q:application id="outpost-door" type="game">
  <!-- a world of a site's accounts: the game signs in, and the ticket the site answers is the world's hello -->
  <qg:connect world="projects/outpost/outpost.server.q" local="ws://127.0.0.1:7700" />
  <qg:tileset name="land" src="projects/outpost/assets/land.png" tile="16" />
  <qg:spritesheet name="folk" src="projects/outpost/assets/folk.png" tile="16" />
  <qg:spritesheet name="beasts" src="projects/outpost/assets/beasts.png" tile="16" />
  <qg:prefab name="Hero" sheet="folk" frame="0" hitbox="14x14"><qg:label value="{me.name}" dy="-14" size="8" /></qg:prefab>
  <qg:prefab name="Trader" sheet="folk" frame="2" hitbox="14x14"><qg:label value="{me.title}" dy="-14" size="8" /></qg:prefab>
  <qg:prefab name="Captain" sheet="folk" frame="3" hitbox="14x14"><qg:label value="{me.title}" dy="-14" size="8" /></qg:prefab>
  <qg:prefab name="Rat" sheet="beasts" frame="0" hitbox="12x10" />
  <qg:prefab name="Wolf" sheet="beasts" frame="1" hitbox="14x12" />
  <qg:prefab name="Bear" sheet="beasts" frame="2" hitbox="28x24" scale="2" />
  <q:set name="account" value="" />
  <q:set name="password" value="" />
  <q:set name="note" value="" />
  <qg:scene name="title" width="480" height="270">
    <qg:menu position="center">
      <qg:field label="Account" bind="account" />
      <qg:field label="Password" bind="password" secret="true" />
      <qg:button label="Enter the world">
        <qg:sign-in to="https://outpost.example/sign-in" data="{ {'account': account, 'password': password} }">
          <qg:on-done><q:set name="password" value="" /><qg:goto-scene name="mainland" /></qg:on-done>
          <qg:on-fail><q:set name="password" value="" /><q:set name="note" value="{reason}" /></qg:on-fail>
        </qg:sign-in>
      </qg:button>
    </qg:menu>
    <qg:hud position="bottom-center"><qg:text value="{note}" color="#ff5555" /></qg:hud>
  </qg:scene>
  <qg:scene name="mainland" width="480" height="270" world="true">
    <qg:tilemap tileset="land" src="projects/outpost/maps/mainland.tmx" />
    <qg:mirror view="around" />
    <qg:camera follow="me" bounds="tilemap" />
    <qg:on-input action="up"><qg:send command="step" dir="north" /></qg:on-input>
    <qg:on-input action="down"><qg:send command="step" dir="south" /></qg:on-input>
  </qg:scene>
</q:application>
